notes.title: Stocker Fix & New Licenses Update
notes.notes: [p]1.⁠ ⁠The major stocker bug has been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p][u]We are truly sorry for the issues it caused. Thank you so much for your patience and support![/u][/p][p][/p][p]2.	5 new licenses have been added![/p][p]Some of them are placed earlier in the license tree, [b]so your unlocked license count stays the same.[/b][/p][p]However, due to this rearrangement, you might need to repurchase some licenses you’ve already unlocked.[/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience and hope you enjoy the new additions![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Join our Discord to report bugs, share suggestions, and ask questions![/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7"]https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p]

notes.title: Hypermarket Simulator - Patch v00.60.081
notes.notes:
[p]This update brings plenty of new items to decorate your store and office, helping you prepare for the upcoming [b]Staff Management Update[/b].[/p][p]
We’ve also added a brand-new extra trash bin that you can freely place anywhere, and now [i]all trash bins are fully movable[/i] for maximum flexibility.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we’ve worked hard on fixing the customer freezing bug, and we believe this issue is finally resolved, meaning smoother gameplay and happier shoppers.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Join our Discord to report bugs, share suggestions, and ask questions![/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7"]https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p]

notes.title: Hypermarket Simulator - Patch v00.60.074
notes.notes: [p]29 Aug 2025 - Patch v00.60.074[/p][p]We’ve been listening to your feedback and packed this patch with fixes, improvements, and exciting new features:[/p][list][*][p]🛒 [b]Customer Fixes[/b] – No more freezing or endless waiting at self-checkouts and racks.[/p][/*][*][p]🏷️ [b]Content Corrections[/b] – Adjusted product names and images for accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Storage Rack Fix[/b] – Boxes no longer disappear when racks touch trash bins.[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 [b]Front Door Update[/b] – Adjusted player collision with the front door.[/p][/*][*][p]❄️ [b]Lighting Tweaks[/b] – Reduced glow from freezers and fridges.[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 [b]New Modular Walls[/b] – Build your dream store layout with doors and windows.[/p][/*][*][p]⚖️ [b]Placement Options[/b] – Choose between [i]Realistic[/i] or [i]Perfectly Aligned[/i] product placement.[/p][/*][*][p]👷 [b]Stocker Upgrade [/b]- The trash bins at the back of the store can now be used by stockers.[/p][/*][*][p]👷 [b]Stocker Upgrade 2[/b] – Maximum stockers increased from 9 → 12.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Performance Improvements[/b] – Smoother gameplay across the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"]Join our Discord to report bugs, share suggestions, and ask questions![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7"]https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p]

notes.title: Hypermarket Simulator – Patch v00.60.072 – Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes: [p][b]23 Aug 2025 — Patch v00.60.072[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed A/C unit shader (no longer too dark at night).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where boxes could disappear when taken from storage space and touching a trash bin.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ground grid to assist with object placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed outlines not appearing on: Shelf Round 4 Racks, Shelf 2 Racks, Shelf 3 Racks, Shelf 4 Racks, Shelf L-Shaped 4 Racks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an extra color to the aim indicator so it remains visible when aiming at white surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Shelves, products, tags, and boxes behind walls or tents can no longer be selected.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Join our Discord to report bugs, share suggestions, and ask questions! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7"]https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
